mentions.name: OpenClaw/Hermes Agent-style home server system
mentions.description: A self-hosted agent system in the style of OpenClaw and Hermes Agent, designed to run on a home server. Built with Rails on the backend and a Tauri 2 front-end.
mentions.source_excerpt: An Openclaw, Hermes Agent type system that is meant to be ran on a home server, built in Rails with a Tauri 2 front-end.
mentions.author: piratebroadcast
